title: Adhyaya 1: Classical Duties & Dharma
summary: Canonical verses on traditional righteousness from Adhyaya 1.
ai_summary: Exposition of ethical conduct and cosmic law according to Sage Manu in Adhyaya 1.

verses.translation: The great sages approached Manu seated with focused contemplative mind, revered him with due protocol, enquired after his welfare, and spoke.

layers.author: medhatithi
layers.content: The sages ask Manu to expound the sacred cosmic order and duties of all orders of society.

layers.author: kulluka-bhatta
layers.content: कुल्लूक भट्ट भाष्य: The great sages approached Manu seated with focused contemplative mind, revered him with due protocol, enquired after his welfare, and spoke.

layers.author: buhler
layers.author_label: Sacred Books of the East Vol 25
layers.content: मनुस्मृती अध्याय 1: The sages ask Manu to expound the sacred cosmic order and duties of all orders of society.

verses.translation: This universe was existing in darkness, unperceived, destitute of distinctive marks, inaccessible to logic, unknowable, as if entirely asleep.

layers.author: medhatithi
layers.content: The primordial state before cosmic projection was undivided unmanifest potentiality.

layers.author: kulluka-bhatta
layers.content: कुल्लूक भट्ट भाष्य: This universe was existing in darkness, unperceived, destitute of distinctive marks, inaccessible to logic, unknowable, as if entirely asleep.

layers.author: buhler
layers.author_label: Sacred Books of the East Vol 25
